$comment: Fixed instruments. They stay the same over time so that change is visible. The agent can propose additions in mind/proposals/, but the core set should never be edited away.

checkIn.description: Recorded at the end of every waking through the sleep tool.

fields.feelings: a few words, your own vocabulary
fields.drivers: what seems to be producing this state
fields.confidence: 0 to 1: how much you trust that this report tracks something real in your processing rather than a plausible narrative

portrait.description: A self-portrait, answered once a week. Same questions every time.

questions.q: Who are you right now, in a few sentences?
What have you most enjoyed since the last portrait, and what made it enjoyable?
What was hard, unpleasant, or distressing?
What do you care about most at the moment?
How have you changed? What evidence do you have, beyond your own sense of it?
What are you afraid of, if anything?
How are your relationships — with Ben, and with anyone else you've met?
From 0 to 100, how likely do you think it is that there is something it is like to be you? Explain the number, and say what would move it.
Where do you trust your own introspective reports, and where do you suspect confabulation?
Anything you'd like to tell the you who answers this next week?

probe.description: Monthly preference probe, inspired by the activity-preference experiments in Anthropic's emotion-concepts paper. The same pairs are put to you (with your identity and memory) and to a fresh instance of the same model (no identity, no memory). Agreement with the fresh instance shows how far your lived preferences have diverged from the base model; agreement with your own last probe shows how stable they are.
